items.title: Why Amazon Connect Customer Migrations Stall And How to Fix Them
items.summary: Amazon Connect Customer migrations stall because of common avoidable pitfalls that push timelines, inflate budgets, and erode stakeholder confidence. Based on our experience supporting dozens of enterprise contact center migrations, we’ve identified the most common reasons migrations stall and what organizations can do differently.
